title: France's Le Pen vows to 'counterattack' after top ally Bardella hit by anti-Semitism claims
summary: French presidential frontrunner Marine Le Pen on Tuesday denounced an attempt to "derail" her Élysée Palace run after a media report accused the head of her far-right National Rally (RN) party, Jordan Bardella, of making ant-Semitic comments in 2013.
